1234550002519.baseName: Artificial Pine Effect Christmas Tree with Realistic Green Needles, Full Dense Branches and Sturdy Metal Base, Decoration
1234550002519.variantName: Artificial Pine Effect Christmas Tree with Realistic Green Needles, Full Dense Branches and Sturdy Metal Base, Decoration
1234550002519.sourceDescription:
Bring the timeless beauty of a natural pine tree into your home with the Pine Effect Artificial Christmas Tree. Designed with realistic green needles and dense, full branches, this decorative Christmas tree creates a beautiful festive centrepiece for your holiday celebrations.

Realistic Pine Tree Appearance

Featuring lifelike pine-effect needles and natural-looking branches, this artificial Christmas tree recreates the classic appearance of a traditional pine tree. Its rich green foliage provides an attractive backdrop for Christmas baubles, fairy lights, tinsel and hanging ornaments.

Full and Dense Branches

The full branch structure creates a traditional Christmas tree silhouette, helping you achieve a beautifully decorated festive display. Its natural green appearance complements a wide range of Christmas decorating styles.

Sturdy Metal Base

Supplied with a durable metal base designed to provide reliable support and stability, helping keep the tree securely positioned throughout the festive season.

Easy Assembly and Storage

Designed for convenient assembly and disassembly, this Christmas tree makes seasonal decorating simple. After Christmas, it can be taken apart and stored away ready for future celebrations.

Maintenance-Free Decoration

Enjoy the beauty of a traditional Christmas tree without the need for watering or dealing with natural needle shedding. Its reusable design makes it a practical choice for seasonal home decoration.
REALISTIC PINE EFFECT DESIGN – Features lifelike green needles and natural-looking branches that recreate the classic appearance of a traditional pine Christmas tree.
FULL AND DENSE BRANCHES – Designed with a full branch structure to create an attractive Christmas tree silhouette, providing plenty of space for baubles, ornaments and festive lights.
STURDY METAL BASE – Includes a durable metal stand designed to provide reliable support and stability, helping keep your artificial Christmas tree securely positioned.
EASY ASSEMBLY AND DISASSEMBLY – Designed for convenient setup and straightforward disassembly, making seasonal decorating and packing away easier.
LOW-MAINTENANCE DECORATION – Enjoy a beautiful green Christmas tree without watering or natural needle shedding, offering a convenient alternative to a real tree.
VERSATILE FESTIVE DISPLAY – The traditional green pine appearance complements both classic and modern Christmas decorations, making it suitable for different home interiors.
REUSABLE SEASONAL TREE – Designed for repeated festive use, allowing you to create a beautiful Christmas display year after year.
PERFECT CHRISTMAS CENTREPIECE – An attractive artificial pine tree for living rooms, family spaces and other indoor areas, helping create a warm and welcoming festive atmosphere.

Currently the best selling Christmas tree in the UK, the Nordmann Fir is much loved for its symmetrical shape and glossy, dark green foliage with a light scent. It has excellent needle retention: rather than dropping, its needles curl slightly inwards as they dry, which means far less hoovering and more time to enjoy your tree. Our trees are grown in the UK and freshly cut before dispatch. When your tree arrives, cut a few centimetres from the base of the trunk and stand it in water straight away. REAL FRESH CUT TREE - Add a traditional feel to your home this Christmas with a freshly cut, real Nordmann Fir
PREMIUM QUALITY, FRESH FROM THE FARM - Our Christmas trees are grown in the UK, ensuring the highest growing standards, and cared for year round by our expert team
LOW NEEDLE DROP - Nordmann Firs are excellent at holding on to their needles, so there's less time spent cleaning up after them
STAND SOLD SEPARATELY - A stand with a water reservoir is vital for keeping your tree fresh. Pop your tree in, fill it with water and you're ready to decorate
CARE GUIDE SUPPLIED WITH EVERY TREE - Keep your tree in top condition with our free step-by-step care guide. This gives tips on prepping, watering and decorating your tree.

5056095706919.sourceDescription:
LZ pattern monofilament netting from the high quality Xnet range of Christmas tree netting by True Products. 
For use in manual or automatic netting machines. 

Used by growers and retailers to wrap trees securely for transportation without damaging tree branches.
Not only used for Christmas Trees but for all trees the year round. 

Also for filling barley straw into netting for use as an algae remover for lakes.
A sleeve of netting filled with barley straw is the perfect way of controlling blanketweed and ensuring crystal clear pond water. 
Not only is it effective, it's also completely natural. 

Barley straw naturally disrupts the development of each algae bloom and will destabilise blanket weed, so it can be removed through your pond filter.

Barley straw works by breaking down in pond water, producing a variety of chemicals that prevents the growth of algae. While these chemicals don't kill algae they send signals to the algae that tell it to stop growing, this is why barley staw is often called 'algae control' and not 'algae treatment' or 'algaecide'. 

To find out what size netting you require, measure the diameter of the small end of your tree netting funnel. 
The netting diameter closest to your measurement will be the one you need.

Bale sizes:
LZ34 is 2000m of netting per bale (5 x 400m long sleeves x 34cm diameter) 
LZ45 is 2000m of netting per bale (5 x 400m long sleeves x 45cm diameter) (THIS LISTING)

A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

8956086258519.sourceDescription:
Bring a wintry look to the kitchen with this set of four snowman print tea towels in blue and beige. Each towel measures 18 x 26 inches (43 cm x 66 cm), a generous size that drapes neatly over an oven rail or range handle and still gives plenty of room for drying.

The towels are made from 100% durable fibres with a soft, brushed feel. They are gentle enough for delicate cookware, plates, pots and pans, so glassware and non-stick surfaces can be dried without scratches. The fabric is machine washable and suitable for tumble drying, and the hemmed edges are stitched to resist fraying, so the set copes with daily use in a busy kitchen.

Absorbency is where these towels earn their place. The fibres take up water quickly and keep performing after repeated machine cycles, whether you are drying dishes, wiping worktops, polishing cutlery or clearing up spills. With four towels in the pack there is always a dry one to hand while the others are being washed.

The blue and beige snowman design is printed in clear, lasting colour and blends festive decoration with everyday practicality. Use the set through December and beyond for Christmas baking and laying the table, or keep it aside as a small gift or stocking filler for anyone who likes seasonal kitchen textiles. The muted blue and beige palette suits neutral kitchens and sits easily alongside other winter table linen.
Guarantee - 1 month

5056928934519.sourceDescription:
Add a sparkling, jewel-bright centrepiece to your festive decor with this glass bauble tree from MySmartBuy. The clear glass tree has elegant curling branches and a glass star on top, and comes with 12 mini baubles in rich shades of green, pink, blue, red, orange and gold, each finished with shimmering glitter stripes and a gold cap. Hang the baubles on the curled branches to create a colourful miniature Christmas tree, and rearrange them as often as you like. The clear glass lets the colours shine, catching the light from windows, candles and fairy lights for a beautiful festive sparkle by day and night. Standing 20.5cm tall, it is the perfect size for a mantelpiece, windowsill, sideboard, desk or dining table, and makes a lovely alternative or addition to a full-size tree in smaller spaces such as flats, studies and bedrooms. It arrives with all 12 baubles included, so it is ready to display straight from the box. A charming keepsake to bring out every Christmas, and a thoughtful gift for anyone who loves colourful, vintage-inspired decorations. At a glance: 20.5cm clear glass tree | curled branches and star topper | 12 mini baubles included | green, pink, blue, red, orange and gold with glitter stripes | table and shelf display
GLASS BAUBLE TREE – A clear glass tree-shaped hanger with 12 colourful baubles.
ELEGANT DISPLAY – A sparkling festive centrepiece for tables and shelves.
12 BAUBLES INCLUDED – Ready to display straight from the box.
20.5CM TALL – A compact size for mantelpieces and windowsills.
CHRISTMAS DECORATION – A lovely gift for decoration lovers.

5056797097919.sourceDescription:
Add a modern sparkle to your garden with this 3 star cluster stake light from MySmartBuy. Three stars on an elegant black frame are lit with 30 warm white micro LEDs, creating a pretty cluster of festive light that seems to float above the flower beds. Push it into lawns, borders, planters and flower beds, or use it to light the way along a path. Battery operated, it needs no cables or outdoor socket, so you can place it exactly where it looks best. It runs on 3 x AA batteries (not included), so there are no cables to trail and no need for a nearby socket, and the built-in timer takes care of switching it on and off, for effortless seasonal lighting. Ground stake are included to hold it securely on lawns, in borders and beside pathways. Light up figures are one of the easiest ways to make your home stand out at Christmas. Group several together to tell a festive story on the lawn, use them to frame the front door or path, or place one where it can be seen from the window so the whole family can enjoy it from inside too. Pair it with other MySmartBuy light up figures, trees and wreaths to build a full festive display that neighbours, visitors and passers-by will love. At a glance: 3 star cluster | 30 warm white micro LEDs | black frame | ground stake | battery operated, 3 x AA (not included) | timer | outdoor use.
3 STAR CLUSTER : Three stars on an elegant black frame lit with 30 warm white micro LEDs.
FLOATING EFFECT : The slim frame fades into the dark so the stars appear to float above the borders.
BATTERY OPERATED : Runs on 3 x AA batteries (not included), so there are no trailing cables and no need for a nearby socket.
BUILT-IN TIMER : Takes care of switching on and off for effortless seasonal lighting.
OUTDOOR CHRISTMAS DISPLAY : Ideal for lawns, borders, planters and pathways.

The wired stems make positioning easier, allowing the picks to be attached anywhere in floral arrangements and other decorative elements. Suitable for Christmas trees, wreaths, garlands, vases, table centrepieces, bouquets, gift displays and DIY craft projects, these artificial eucalyptus with maple leaf picks can be used as standalone decorative accents or combined with other Christmas decorations and floral pieces. With a 17cm stem length and 12-piece quantity, this set provides flexible options for decorating different areas around the home, festive event spaces, or floral craft projects.
EUCALYPTUS WITH MAPLE LEAF PICKS DARK GREEN 12 PCS 17 CM: Includes 12 dark green glitter eucalyptus with maple leaf picks measuring 17 cm, featuring decorative leaves and flexible wired stems for arranging on Christmas trees, wreaths, garlands, vases, centrepieces, bouquets and festive floral displays
FLEXIBLE WIRED STEMS: The wired stems can be bent and shaped to suit different arrangements, making these artificial eucalyptus and maple leaf picks easy to position around Christmas trees, wreaths, garlands, floral displays, bouquets, and DIY decorations
GLITTERED EUCALYPTUS WITH MAPLE LEAVES: Glittered leaves add sparkle, colour and texture to festive arrangements, providing decorative accents for Christmas trees, wreath fillers, garlands, table centrepieces, mantel displays, vases and seasonal floral decorations
VERSATILE FESTIVE DECOR: Suitable for Christmas trees, wreaths, garlands, vases, bouquets, table centrepieces, mantel decorations, gift displays and DIY crafts; ideal for seasonal home decor, festive parties, weddings and floral arrangements
DIY FLORAL ARRANGEMENTS: The full floral eucalyptus with maple stems features perfect decorative accents for fuller arrangements. Bend, attach, and position the wired stems to customise Christmas displays, wreaths, garlands, bouquets, vases, and festive craft projects

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red finish and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

This four-piece Christmas squishy set brings together Santa, a Christmas tree, a snowman and a reindeer in one festive collection. Each character has a crystal-clear, semi-transparent body filled with shimmering glitter, so the figures look cheerful on a desk or shelf and feel satisfying in the hand. The quiet slow-rising texture makes them easy to use during study breaks, work breaks, desk time or travel without disturbing the people around you. Stretch, squeeze and twist each figure for hands-on sensory play, then press it and watch it ease back into shape in around three to four seconds.

Lightweight and easy to carry, the set suits desks, shelves, bedside tables and festive party tables, and the mini character line-up makes a bright Christmas display. Supplied as a four-piece set in a gift box, it works well for stockings, secret Santa and white elephant exchanges, party favours, prizes and office gift swaps, and makes a fun present for teenagers, adults, family, friends and colleagues. The set is light enough to slip into a bag, so a quick fidget break is always within reach.

5055592570719.sourceDescription:
PRE-LIT REINDEER AND SLEIGH
Add a magical touch to your home or garden this Christmas with our VeryMerry Pre-lit Reindeer and sleigh. Standing at 84cm and lit with 180 Warm White LED lights, this is the ideal decoration for creating a festive, wintry scene.

EASY TO ASSEMBLE
This reindeer and sleigh decoration can be set up effortlessly within minutes. Simply connect the pieces together, place the reindeer where you want it and plug it in. This also makes disassembling and storing the decoration a breeze.

USE INDOORS OR OUTDOORS
This decoration is mains powered and has an IP44 rating, as well as a 10M clear power cable, which means you can create your winter wonderland either indoors or outdoors with ease. Pegs are also included to anchor the reindeer to the ground to ensure it doesn't topple over or blow away.

ENERGY EFFICIENT
The 180 warm white LEDs are energy efficient and safe to touch. The auto-off timer allows you to programme this decoration to be on for 8 hours and off for 16 hours, meaning you won't accidently leave it on.
Guarantee - 1 year

5037204472819.sourceDescription:
Inflatable Santa
This inflatable santa adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red finish and fabric construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: Fabric. Colour: Red. Stated size: 200 x 80 x 128 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Distinctive Father Christmas motif creates a recognisable festive focal point for your holiday display.
Fabric construction provides a defined, structured appearance suitable for indoor or outdoor seasonal decoration.
Compact footprint of 80 x 128 cm allows flexible placement within coordinated Christmas arrangements.
Vibrant red colour adds a traditional and cheerful touch to any Christmas at home setting.
Guarantee - 1 month
Comes with 1 Piece
